- **Menus run at 60 FPS in 4K.** Home, Discover, details and Settings are now
  drawn by the PS5's graphics chip at full 4K, so scrolling and switching tabs
  is smooth instead of about 20 frames a second. Playback is unchanged.
- **Blu-ray and DVD subtitles play on the PS5.** Picture subtitle tracks (PGS
  and DVD) inside MKV files are now drawn by SlopFin itself, sharp at 4K,
  instead of your server burning them into the video. Text and picture
  subtitles each have their own look settings and their own Reset.

Update in **Settings → Updates**, or install the complete **folder ZIP** below.
Sign-in and preferences are preserved. [Update guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md).
